seoTitle: Freelance Hourly Rate Calculator From Income Target
metaDescription: Find the hourly rate you need for a take-home target after expenses, tax and realistic billable hours. Free and private.
intro: Works backwards from the income you want to the hourly rate you need to charge.
why:
Most freelancers cannot bill every working hour. Admin, sales and gaps take a large share, so the rate must be higher than salary divided by 2080. Tax and expenses add to what you need.

Enter your target take-home, expenses, tax rate estimate, working weeks and the share of time you bill. The tax rate is your own estimate. A buffer line shows the rate with 15 percent extra.
howTo: Enter your take-home target and expenses.
Enter your tax estimate and weeks and hours worked.
Set billable share and read the rate.

faq.a: Many freelancers bill 50 to 70 percent of working hours. Use your own history.

faq.q: Which tax rate should I use?
faq.a: Ask an accountant. The tool does not know your country.
